title: Bisphenol a alternatives suppress human and rat aromatase activity: QSAR structure-activity relationship and in silico docking analysis.
authors: Xia, Miaomiao; Zheng, Jingyi; Chen, Sailin; Tang, Yunbing; Wang, Shaowei; Ji, Zhongyao; Hao, Ting; Li, Huitao; Li, Linxi; Ge, Ren-Shan; Liu, Yi
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双酚A替代物对人/大鼠芳香化酶的抑制活性，含QSAR与分子对接分析，但对象为酶-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The use of alternative substances to replace bisphenol A (BPA) has been encouraged. The objective of this study was to evaluate the effects of BPA and 9 BPA alternatives on human and rat aromatase (CYP19A1) in human and rat placental microsomes. The results revealed that bisphenol A, AP, B, C, E, F, FL, S, and Z, and 4,4'-thiodiphenol (TDP) inhibited human CYP19A1 and bisphenol A, AP, B, C, FL, Z, and TDP inhibited rat CYP19A1. The IC(50) values of human CYP19A1 ranged from 3.3 to 172.63 muM and those of rat CYP19A1 ranged from 2.20 to over 100 muM. BPA alternatives were mixed/competitive inhibitors and inhibited estradiol production in BeWo placental cells. Molecular docking analysis showed that BPA alternatives bind to the domain between heme and steroid and form a hydrogen bond with catalytic residue Met374. Pharmacophore analysis showed that there were one hydrogen bond donor, one hydrophobic region, and one ring aromatic hydrophobic region. Bivariate correlation analysis showed that molecular weight, alkyl atom weight, and LogP of BPA alternatives were inversely correlated with their IC(50) values. In conclusion, BPA alternatives can inhibit human and rat CYP19A1 and the lipophilicity and the substituted alkyl size determines their inhibitory strength.
abstract_zh: 使用替代物质来取代双酚A（BPA）已被鼓励。本研究旨在评估BPA及9种BPA替代物对人及大鼠胎盘微粒体中芳香化酶（CYP19A1）的影响。结果显示，双酚A、AP、B、C、E、F、FL、S和Z，以及4,4'-硫代二苯酚（TDP）抑制了人CYP19A1，而双酚A、AP、B、C、FL、Z和TDP抑制了大鼠CYP19A1。人CYP19A1的IC(50)值范围为3.3至172.63微摩尔，大鼠CYP19A1的IC(50)值范围为2.20至超过100微摩尔。BPA替代物为混合/竞争性抑制剂，并抑制了BeWo胎盘细胞中雌二醇的产生。分子对接分析显示，BPA替代物结合在血红素和类固醇之间的结构域，并与催化残基Met374形成氢键。药效团分析显示，存在一个氢键供体、一个疏水区域和一个芳香环疏水区域。双变量相关分析显示，BPA替代物的分子量、烷基原子量和LogP与其IC(50)值呈负相关。总之，BPA替代物可抑制人和大鼠CYP19A1，其亲脂性和取代烷基大小决定了其抑制强度。
